# SNCF

Access SNCF passenger-information data for train journeys, stations, schedules, service status, and transport-network discovery.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sncf/.

## Actions

- **Find Nearby Places** (read-only): Find SNCF stations, stops, or points of interest near a geographic coordinate.
- **Get Service Status** (read-only): Get SNCF network service disruptions and affected lines, stations, or vehicle journeys for a time window.
- **Get SNCF Coverage** (read-only): Get the SNCF transport-data coverage region and its current production horizon.
- **Get Station Board** (read-only): Get upcoming departures or arrivals for an SNCF station, including scheduled and realtime times and disruption context.
- **Get Transport Object** (read-only): Get details for one SNCF network, line, route, station, stop, mode, company, or vehicle journey by canonical ID.
- **List Transport Objects** (read-only): Browse one supported SNCF transport-object collection, such as lines, networks, routes, stations, or vehicle journeys.
- **Plan Journey** (read-only): Plan SNCF train journeys between two station/place IDs or coordinates for a requested departure or arrival time.
- **Search Places** (read-only): Find SNCF stations, addresses, administrative areas, or points of interest by name and return IDs usable for journeys and station boards.
- **Search Transport Objects** (read-only): Search SNCF networks, modes, lines, routes, stations, or stop points by name and return canonical transport-object IDs.
